name: project
description: Inspect files in the current visible project through read-only operations without shell, network, or write access.

tools.name: files
tools.description: List file and symbolic-link entries recursively below a project-relative path. Symbolic links are listed but never followed.

path.description: Project-relative file or directory path. Defaults to the project root.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a regular file, or the target path stored in a symbolic-link entry, from the visible project or an absolute Canon prompt-artifact path. Symbolic links are never followed. Output includes line numbers and is bounded.

path.description: Project-relative path or absolute prompt-artifact path.

startLine.description: First one-based line to return. Defaults to 1.

endLine.description: Last one-based line to return, inclusive.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search visible project files and stored symbolic-link target paths for a literal string. Symbolic links are never followed. Results use project-relative path:line references and are bounded.

query.description: Literal text to find, from 1 through 1024 Unicode characters.

path.description: Project-relative file or directory path. Defaults to the project root.
